column1: # Rows db.pmask.* (series NP, M4b PR 1; ncbi-parity-20261019/M/m4b/SURVEY.md §1, §3, NOTES_M4B1.md): BLASTP -db_soft_mask and -db_hard_mask on the protein databases of ../db_search/dbmaskp (README.md there): seg masks (ps5 with the sequence p4 masked whole, ph5 without it, ph4 version 4, phmv several volumes, the list ph5 phmv) and the hand masks of p5 (pe_*), in outfmt 0 (Masked using, lowercase), 5, 6 with the letters, 11, the composition-based statistics 0 to 3 and the fast task; the refusals of masks out of order. Review of PR 1: outfmt 1 to 4, an alias file (pal), a search with -window_size 0, two -db names with parsed Seq-ids that share p5 under different masks (pl3a, pl3b), the option errors (id 99, id 0, a name), and -subject_besthit across a mask (pbh). Resume 2 of PR 1: pieces between masks shorter than the word with -window_size 0 (pe_tiny, pe_gap2, pe_adjacent; pshort, whose pieces sit at a W run of the query), searched as NCBI searches them, and the soft one-hit scan of a first range shorter than the word. M4b-3 (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 21, the Owner's answers Q1 = B and Q2 = B of 2026-11-21): a sequence whose first mask runs to its end is searched over the part before the mask (rows .hard.tail.*), with NCBI's bytes or, with ncbi-near:, those of NCBI's run of the near input (rows .hard.near.*: the mask one letter shorter, the freed letter stored as X). M4b-3b (overlapping hard masks, the fixture agent of ad-M4b-6, 2026-11-22): the rows .hard.ov_* search the databases ov_* and ov_atha of ../db_search/dbmaskp (masks that start before the previous one ends: inverted chunks) with the default two-hit search, -evalue 1000, -window_size 0 and -ungapped, outfmt 6 (ov_atha also outfmt 0); rows whose NCBI run does not end (ov_g3 gapped two-hit BLASTP: its interval tree splits without end) are losat-rejection rows that expect LOSAT's refusal text; fix round 1 of M4b-3b (review H1, M1, H2, L1): ov_s2's seed in a chunk shorter than the word and ov_nb are searched as NCBI searches them (ncbi rows), ov_tl (a mask that runs to the end with a mask stored after it) is refused before the search, and ov_wpe (a one word past a sequence's end) is searched, also for a query file with a gap letter, which the FASTA reader drops. Follow-up (17:4x): ov_athaw (ov_atha without six proteins) has one-hit ncbi rows. Q5 = B (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 23, the Owner's answer Q5 = B of M4b, 2026-11-22 22:34 JST): LOSAT scans each sequence with the diagonal entries of the sequences before it out of reach (no longer a refusal), so ov_atha at -window_size 0 and ov_lk at the default are ncbi rows with NCBI's bytes and the other ov_lk rows but -window_size 0 take those of NCBI's run of the near input ov_lkn (rows .hard.near.ov_lkn.*: a spacer of X between A and B; ncbi-near:). Fix round 2 of M4b-3b (review 2 M1, L7; DECISIONS 55 of series M): a sequence whose walk meets the entries that no sequence wrote in NCBI's one-thread search starts on a new table at NCBI's one-thread offset, so ov_lk at -window_size 0 (B at -98) has NCBI's one-thread bytes (its near input ov_lkx, A's letters X: B's rows the same), and ov_zt (B 70 below its start at 5), ov_ztl (at 100) and ov_zto (an alias of ov_zt's OID 2: B first) have NCBI's one-thread bytes, checked at 1 and 4 threads.
